text:
samira.r: hi all, first day! got a company MacBook Air (M2, serial ZN45X7Q). after the initial sign-in Company Portal says "Device management pending" and System Preferences shows FileVault not enabled. trying to run Docker and it errors "bad CPU type in executable". also Homebrew install asks for admin. any quick guidance for remote onboarding?

mdm-bot: new device detected serial=ZN45X7Q state=enroll_pending. Self-service re-enroll: https://idp.redwood.example.com/self-enroll. If on guest network, switch to corp-secure or use corp-vpn.

samira.r: i'm remote on a cafe wifi atm. i'll try corp-vpn. quick q: is FileVault usually pushed immediately or after enrollment?

emily.it: welcome! MDM usually pushes a FileVault policy after enrollment which prompts you to enable encryption. If the device shows DEP/serial pending we may need to kick a manual push. can you run and paste these two outputs (short lines only)?
```
/usr/bin/fdesetup status
profiles show --type enrollment
```

samira.r: pasted:
```
FileVault is Off
Enrollment status: Pending
MDM Server: jamf.redwood.local
```

oz.sre: Docker error = Rosetta missing. Once you have sudo run: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` then install the Apple Silicon Docker Desktop. We don't give permanent admin; IT can grant a time-limited admin token.

emily.it: opening ticket IT-4987 with serial + screenshot. i'll attempt a remote re-enroll push now. if the push doesn't complete we'll grant a 24h temporary admin for the steps you listed (Rosetta, Docker, homebrew).

mdm-bot: re-enroll job queued for ZN45X7Q (job=2026-03-12-09). status: queued -> running.

samira.r: thanks — also curious: will enabling FileVault ask me to create a recovery key or will Jamf escrow it? don't want to lose access to personal password copies.

emily.it: Jamf will escrow the recovery key when the FileVault profile is pushed if bootstrap token is present. if bootstrap token rotation is needed we'll do that as part of the push. you'll get an OS dialog to enable and a confirmation that recovery info is stored.

mdm-bot: re-enroll job complete: device now managed.

emily.it: pushing FileVault policy and requesting bootstrap token rotation now. you should see a system dialog shortly to enable FileVault under your corporate account (samira.r@redwood.com). proceed and paste `fdesetup status` after.

samira.r: dialog appeared, enabled FileVault, got confirmation about recovery being saved. `fdesetup status` now: `FileVault is On.` :tada:

emily.it: temporary admin granted (24h) for IT-4987. you should be able to run the Rosetta installer and Homebrew/Docker steps. ticket updated with scope and expiry.

os.sre: small checklist: 1) confirm `profiles show --type enrollment` -> Enrolled: Yes, 2) `fdesetup status` -> shows On, 3) install rosetta + Apple Silicon Docker, 4) remove temp admin in ticket notes when done.

samira.r: installed rosetta & Docker, Homebrew works now, containers start. i'll add the exact commands to IT-4987 for the runbook. thanks everyone!

clara-devex: welcome and thanks for documenting — we'll fold this into the new-hires runbook (note about cafe/guest wifi causing enroll failures). :wave:
